company.name: Deskimo
company.shortDescription: Deskimo is a desk booking app that provides remote workforce access to desk space.
company.description:
Deskimo is a desk booking app that provides remote workforce access to desk space. Deskimo connects mobile working professionals with quality workspaces all over Singapore.

Deskimo's network of vetted workspaces all across Singapore and Hong Kong allows anyone to discover, work, and pay by the minute for workspace.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that enables businesses and individuals to find and book various workspaces on-demand with flexible booking options and transparent pricing.
productsAndServices.name: Deskimo Flexible Workspace Booking Platform

productsAndServices.description: A flexible private office rental service allowing users to rent office space part-time with customizable days, team size, budget, and location, without long-term commitments.
productsAndServices.name: Deskimo FlexiOffice

productsAndServices.description: A service that allows workspace owners to list and monetize their under-utilized office spaces by connecting with Deskimo’s user base.
productsAndServices.name: Deskimo Workspace Partner Program

productsAndServices.description: A mobile app that allows users to find, book, and check in to workspaces instantly, paying only for the time used without advance reservations.
productsAndServices.name: Deskimo Mobile Application

productsAndServices.description: A service to assist landlords and tenants in Dubai with registering, renewing, and amending tenancy contracts in compliance with Dubai’s Ejari system.
productsAndServices.name: Ejari Registration Service
